cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(ProjectZMonoGameNative LANGUAGES C CXX)
if(NOT WIN32 OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "This patch builds the Windows x64 DX12 runtime.")
endif()
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
set(SDL_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${MONOGAME_SOURCE}/native/monogame/external/sdl2/sdl" sdl EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
set(native "${MONOGAME_SOURCE}/native/monogame")
file(GLOB sources "${native}/common/*.cpp" "${native}/sdl/*.cpp" "${native}/directx12/*.cpp" "${native}/xaudio/*.cpp")
add_library(monogame_objects OBJECT ${sources})
target_compile_features(monogame_objects PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(monogame_objects PUBLIC DLL_EXPORT MG_SDL2 MG_DIRECTX12 MG_XAUDIO _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
target_include_directories(monogame_objects PUBLIC "${native}/include" "${native}/external/sdl2/sdl/include" "${MONOGAME_SOURCE}/external/stb")
target_link_libraries(monogame_objects PUBLIC SDL2-static dxguid dxgi d3d12 xaudio2 winmm imm32 user32 gdi32 advapi32 setupapi ole32 oleaut32 version shell32)
target_compile_options(monogame_objects PRIVATE /Zi /utf-8)
add_library(mgruntime SHARED)
target_link_libraries(mgruntime PRIVATE monogame_objects)
target_link_options(mgruntime PRIVATE /DEBUG)
if(PROJECTZ_NATIVE_TESTS)
  add_executable(ProjectZFenceWait "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../tests/GraphicsFence/FenceWait.cpp")
  target_include_directories(ProjectZFenceWait PRIVATE "${native}/directx12")
  target_link_libraries(ProjectZFenceWait PRIVATE monogame_objects)
  add_library(ProjectZ.NativeExceptionFixture SHARED "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../tests/CrashDiagnostics/NativeGraphicsExceptionFixture.cpp")
endif()
if(PROJECTZ_BASELINE_QUEUE)
  add_executable(ProjectZFenceBaseline "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../tests/GraphicsFence/FenceWait.cpp" "${PROJECTZ_BASELINE_QUEUE}")
  target_compile_features(ProjectZFenceBaseline PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_compile_definitions(ProjectZFenceBaseline PRIVATE PROJECTZ_FENCE_BASELINE)
  target_include_directories(ProjectZFenceBaseline PRIVATE "${native}/include" "${native}/directx12")
  target_link_libraries(ProjectZFenceBaseline PRIVATE dxguid dxgi d3d12)
endif()
